data.strFullDescription:
This Prologue is a limited version of the full game to stop waiting and jump into running your supermarket already. Don't forget to wishlist the full game to continue your most fun supermarket experience.
[img width="800" height="100"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2772560/extras/a489935dcdb5056ac54174670a85e2c5.avif?t=1706285874[/img]
Design your store, optimizing for efficiency and aesthetics. Determine where products are displayed, manage your aisles, and ensure a smooth shopping experience for your customers.

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2772560/extras/7caea642c4f228b02d4390d6328a8e76.poster.avif?t=1706285874" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2772560/extras/7caea642c4f228b02d4390d6328a8e76.webm?t=1706285874" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid]
[img width="800" height="100"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2772560/extras/02fbc65e8149a375deab5ffe093e3825.avif?t=1706285874[/img]
Order stock using an in-game computer and anticipate the arrival of your next delivery. Unpack goods, organize them in your storage room and display them on shelves, fridges, and freezers.

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2772560/extras/10c145773a35def02c2514436cc734f7.poster.avif?t=1706285874" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2772560/extras/10c145773a35def02c2514436cc734f7.webm?t=1706285874" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid]
[img width="800" height="100"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2772560/extras/3822f310202e20f1ced3d3dce4483c56.avif?t=1706285874[/img]
Read product barcodes, handle cash and credit card transactions, and ensure customers leave satisfied with their shopping and checkout experience.

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2772560/extras/b3119ef824bf1dc430b315be9af31c97.poster.avif?t=1706285874" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2772560/extras/b3119ef824bf1dc430b315be9af31c97.webm?t=1706285874" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid]
[img width="800" height="100"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2772560/extras/8fa84d290c7fbb12a7f4287d4b3e602e.avif?t=1706285874[/img]
Navigate the complexities of a real-time market. Buy products when prices dip and determine the best-selling prices to balance customer satisfaction with profit margins.

[imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2772560/extras/924c185a7edd2561241869fb3e331ea2.poster.avif?t=1706285874" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2772560/extras/924c185a7edd2561241869fb3e331ea2.webm?t=1706285874" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid]

Wishlist the full game "Supermarket Simulator" where every decision matters. Will you rise to the occasion, transforming a modest establishment into a retail powerhouse, all while balancing customer satisfaction, finances, and mafia expectations?
data.strSnippet: Start running your own supermarket with Prologue already. Stock shelves, handle cashier tasks, process online orders, design & expand. Set the prices based on the market. Be prepared to face the consequences if you fail to make the nightly repayment to the gangs.
